$comment: Single source of truth for agent-request detection, shared by the twin implementations: isAgentRequest in packages/routing/src/match.ts (validates + simulates) and _stattic_is_agent_request in runtime/engine/runtime/redirects.php (serves). Consumed by packages/routing/src/agent-detection.test.ts (TS, direct) and runtime/tests/agent-detection.test.ts (PHP, real HTTP through php -S). The twins drifted once (PHP missed text/markdown, PR #417); any future widening must land here first or the un-widened side goes red. acceptTokens and needles are also parity-checked against both implementation sources, so a needle or accept token added to only one implementation fails even without a new case.

cases.note: curl default shell fetch
wget default shell fetch
user-agent needle match is case-insensitive
bare text/plain accept is an agent even with no user agent
bare text/markdown accept is an agent (the PR #417 drift: PHP once missed this)
markdown/plain preference with q-values still prefers text without html
a known agent user agent wins even when it asks for html
chatgpt browsing user agent with a browser-shaped accept
gptbot crawler self-identification
perplexity fetcher
needle match works with no accept header at all
accept matching is case-insensitive
text token position does not matter: non-leading text/plain without html is an agent
q-values are ignored (substring semantics, pinned): even text/html;q=0 counts as asking for html
browser: full browser accept and a real Chrome user agent
